name: Isobel Murray
bio:
Isobel's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a family trip to Knockhill Racing Circuit as a child. The roar of the engines and the vibrant atmosphere ignited a passion that never faded. After graduating with a degree in Marketing and Communications, she sought out internships within the motorsport industry, quickly proving her aptitude for brand building and fan engagement.

Isobel thrives on developing innovative marketing strategies that capture the essence of motorsport while connecting with diverse audiences. Her knack for identifying emerging trends, combined with her strong understanding of technical aspects, allows her to create compelling campaigns that resonate with both seasoned enthusiasts and newcomers alike. She believes in a collaborative approach, fostering strong relationships with teams, drivers, and media partners to ensure maximum impact and brand visibility. She is driven by the desire to elevate the sport and make it more accessible to everyone.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail during events
physical.description: Isobel has a smattering of freckles across her nose and a determined set to her jaw.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even in the middle of a race.
Has a lucky tartan scarf that she wears to every major event.
Insists on having a proper cup of tea before starting any new marketing campaign.
